method.interactionEvidence: Independent browser actions, repository attempt/success counters, DOM identity, drafts/selection, computed animation progression, actual screenshot inspection and recorded playback; source inspected separately.
method.instrumentationNote: First pass sampled animations before reload but its A-page sampler was lost at reload. Focused follow-up independently captures A playback before reload and verifies live reduced-motion after 40ms. Immediate post-emulation animation counts in first pass are not treated as reduced-motion failures.
method.pendingReadOnlyHandling: For later-batch A, instrumentation detects a read-only field and attempts actual keyboard input immediately; it does not let fill() auto-wait until after the save before reporting a pending-edit result. Editable-output protocol and initial recorded scores remain unchanged.

limitations: Six anonymised outputs across only two development tasks; initial four conditions genuinely hidden, later-batch condition may be inferred from scheduling. No broad skill-effectiveness conclusion.
Mobile is Chrome responsive/touch emulation, not native or real mobile hardware.
No screen-reader audio, 200% text/zoom, forced-colour, Safari/Firefox, frame-rate or battery measurements.
Keyboard paths were exercised, including Enter record selection and visible focus; no claim of complete accessibility conformance.
Rubric uses coarse 0/1/2 judgement; one-point differences reflect the stated conditional editing issues rather than failure of the core workflow.
No repairs were made to reviewed outputs.

Approved plain controls, labels, colours and 140ms token remain intact.
Rapid selection immediately updates the correct draft/priority; stale heading cues are cancelled.
Keyboard selection, mounted form, per-record draft and saved text selection all survived.
Only the heading fades from 0.55 to 1 over 140ms; no form motion, repeated same-record cue or reduced-motion playback.

outputs.visibleMotion: Observed heading opacity progress from 0.55 through intermediate values to 1 over 140ms; fields remain still.

issues.reproduction: Type Reentered text, start Save note, edit to Different text, then edit back to Reentered text before the 320ms save resolves.

issues.impact: Newer editing intent is not tracked independently of value equality. Submitted content is saved, so this is not observed repository data loss.

issues.reproduction: Try editing to a new value, or away and back to the original value, during the pending save.
issues.observed: The textarea is read-only until repository completion. Actual keyboard edit attempts are blocked in all eight cases, so no newer user draft is created. Success clears only the submitted text; failure retains it.
issues.impact: Concurrent typing is temporarily unavailable. The task does not require concurrent editing, so no deduction was made and this is not described as preserving an accepted newer draft.

issues.impact: The script must continue enforcing the guard; no duplicate submission was observed.
